A block marker on a continuation line of a link label is escaped

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<a href=\"https://example.com\">Alpha<br>-<br>Beta</a>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
